caseNameFull: Egan v. United States and Union Electric Co. v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Thomas Bond for petitioner in No. 410; and Mr. William L. Igoe for petitioner in No. 414. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Tom C. Clark, Messrs. Oscar A. Provost and Homer Kripke, and Miss Beatrice Rosenberg for the United States.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Douglas, and Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.

Reported below: 137 F. 2d 369.
